claim_verdicts.evidence: "In Kubernetes, _namespaces_ provide a mechanism for isolating groups of resources within a single cluster. Names of resources need to be unique within a namespace, but not across namespaces." Lesson section 3 wording ("may share a name only when they are in different namespaces") matches for namespaced kinds.

Docs: "when kubectl runs outside a cluster and you don't specify a namespace, the kubectl command acts against the namespace set for the current context in your client configuration." Executed (kubectl v1.34.3): `kubectl config view --minify -o jsonpath='{..namespace}'` -> empty for context kind-donhang; `kubectl get pods -o wide` -> "No resources found in default namespace."

Docs: "Kubernetes starts with four initial namespaces: default ... kube-node-lease ... kube-public ... kube-system: The namespace for objects created by the Kubernetes system." Executed `kubectl get ns`: default, donhang, kube-node-lease, kube-public, kube-system, local-path-storage (all Active).

Docs: "namespace resources are not themselves in a namespace. And low-level resources, such as Nodes and PersistentVolumes, are not in any namespace." Executed: `kubectl get nodes -n donhang` lists the same 3 nodes as `kubectl get nodes` (donhang-control-plane, donhang-worker, donhang-worker2); `kubectl get ns -n donhang` lists all namespaces.
"Namespaces cannot be nested inside one another and each Kubernetes resource can only be in one namespace."

Network policies: "By default, a pod is non-isolated for ingress; all inbound connections are allowed." Multi-tenancy: "RBAC Roles and Network Policies are namespace-scoped resources. Using RBAC, Users and Service Accounts can be restricted to a namespace." (i.e. restriction comes from those separate objects, not the namespace). `kubectl get networkpolicy -A` -> No resources found.

Nodes are cluster-scoped (namespaces.md: "Nodes ... are not in any namespace"). Executed `kubectl get pods -A -o custom-columns=NS,NAME,NODE`: donhang Pods run on donhang-worker and donhang-worker2; kube-system kindnet/kube-proxy Pods run on the same donhang-worker and donhang-worker2.

namespace.yaml@stage-2 lines 1-7 match (kind: Namespace, name: donhang). grep over every file in git ls-tree stage-2 deploy/k8s: all Kubernetes manifests except namespace.yaml (cluster-scoped) and lessons/web-pod.yaml carry `namespace: donhang` (api, db, keycloak, redis, mailpit, api-configmap, migrate-pod, lessons/*). web-pod.yaml line 5: "There is no namespace field, so it goes to the current context's namespace."
"Delete a namespace with kubectl delete namespaces <insert-some-namespace-name> ... This deletes _everything_ under the namespace!"

Script lines 8-21 match stage-2 character-for-character. Lesson output block matches git show stage-2:outputs/stage-2/scripts/k8s/namespaces.txt exactly (namespace/donhang created; six namespaces; Error from server (NotFound): pods "web" not found). Script not executed (would delete the shared donhang namespace).

kubectl get reference: "-A, --all-namespaces: If present, list the requested object(s) across all namespaces." Executed `kubectl get pods -n kube-system`: 12 Pods incl. etcd-donhang-control-plane, kube-apiserver-donhang-control-plane (2 coredns, 3 kindnet, 3 kube-proxy, etcd, apiserver, controller-manager, scheduler). `get pods -A` output has NAMESPACE column.

Docs: "All pods can communicate with all other pods, whether they are on the same node or on different nodes." (barring intentional segmentation). No NetworkPolicy in cluster. Executed: `kubectl run review-tmp-ns -n donhang --image=caddy:2.10.0 --rm -i -- wget -qO- -T 5 http://10.244.0.2:8080/health` (coredns Pod IP in kube-system) -> "OK"; Pod deleted. Cross-namespace by Pod IP works.

issues.text: `show kubectl get pod web -n donhang || true` is the script's last line, so nothing follows to 'keep going' to. The script runs under `set -euo pipefail` (line 4, not shown); what `|| true` does is make the failed lookup not end the script with an error status.
issues.quote: `|| true` keeps the script going when the last command fails with `NotFound`
issues.fix: Change to: "`|| true` lets the script finish without an error when the last command fails with `NotFound`."

issues.text: Executed `kubectl get pods -n kube-system -o wide`: 12 Pods = 4 control-plane (etcd, kube-apiserver, kube-controller-manager, kube-scheduler), 6 per-node (3 kindnet, 3 kube-proxy) and 2 coredns on the control-plane node, which are neither. The phrase reads as an exhaustive split.
issues.quote: lists more than ten Pods, the control plane's and some that help each node run
issues.fix: Change to: "lists more than ten Pods, the control plane's among them." (avoids naming coredns/kube-proxy, which depth_notes of the next lesson exclude).
